# Vendored files

## supabase-js-2.118.0.js

The official Supabase JavaScript client, `@supabase/supabase-js` version **2.118.0** (published
2026-10-15), UMD build, unmodified. It defines `window.supabase`; `js/auth.js` makes the one client
both the home site and the health app use.

- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.118.0/dist/umd/supabase.js
- Licence: MIT (Copyright (c) 2020 Supabase), https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js/blob/master/LICENSE
- SHA-256: `ee3be8de192b97cb1d73d1e95d6b82bb1f6b658c0f97c4ef757fc331996ed3d3`

To update: download the new version's `dist/umd/supabase.js` from the same address with the exact
version in it (one at least two weeks old), save it under its versioned name, update the two
`<script>` tags (`apps/web/index.html`, `apps/web/public/home/index.html`) and this file.
